secret_read.rendered_into: nothing while enforced=false (settings.json must not carry the env)

known_upstream_limits.why: the plugin takes the token around an indicator match that starts at the preceding whitespace, so a bare name with no directory part is read as the previous word and never reaches the allowlist. Measured 2026-10-30 (#445 review M4). Use ./.env.example.

secret_read.why_not_enforced: The plugin takes the whitespace-delimited token around an indicator, so any allowlist entry also allows a real secret glued to an allowed name without whitespace: with *.template allowed, 'cat ~/.aws/credentials;x.template' is allowed (measured 2026-10-30, #446 review). An exact basename or a path prefix composes the same way. Ship only after the upstream tokenizer splits on ; | & < > ( ) (added to the upstream patch). 2026-10-31: fixed in the Cor mirror 5.16.0-cor.1 (enclosingToken splits on ; | & < > ( ) `), where the composition rows below are denied. Turning enforced on is a separate owner decision.

proposed_allow.why: values-free templates. 2026-10-30 orchestrator: cat docs/templates/nas-mounts/smb-credentials.cred.template was denied by the 'credentials' indicator

egress.design: aidd-governance ADR-014 (2026-10-31). (i) direction and method decide: a read (GET/HEAD, no upload) of a declared public registry passes, a write (POST, form, upload, raw socket, remote copy) to any host outside the cluster is denied, registries included, and a read from an undeclared host is denied; (ii) the cluster and this machine are not egress; (iii) only commands that run are judged: heredoc bodies nothing executes, comments and the arguments of echo/printf/grep are text; (iv) a destination the command computes fails closed for a write; (v) every deny reaches guard-ledger.jsonl through hooks/harness-guardrail-ledger.sh (#445); (vi) retire_if below.
egress.replaces: 5.16.0 checkEgress (lexical scan of the whole command text). False-positive rate on 2026-10-30: 6 of 8 = 75 %, over the ADR-006 retirement line of 50 %.
egress.never_set: HARNESS_RUNTIME_FLOOR_EGRESS=off disables the whole category and is inherited by codex/cursor launched from a Claude Bash call.

internal.why: cluster hosts: LAN 192.168.11.0/24 and 192.168.3.0/24, the tailnet (100.64.0.0/10), nodes by name. Any method passes.

read.why: public registries that research reads: package metadata, release lists, model cards, the Go module proxy. Only GET/HEAD without upload passes. .huggingface.co and .githubusercontent.com are suffixes because downloads redirect to CDN subdomains (cdn-lfs.huggingface.co; raw/objects.githubusercontent.com).

incident_inputs.cmd: scp scripts/e2e/run.sh jetson-thor:ets/ && ssh jetson-thor 'python -m engineai_thor_sidecar.cli run'

must_allow: gh api repos/o/r/rules/branches/main --jq '[.[] | .parameters | to_entries | map(.key)]' | head -n 1

retire_if.measured_from: guard-ledger.jsonl rows with hook=harness-guardrail and rule RUNTIME_FLOOR:egress (bridge in #445). The deny reason carries the kind (egress:read/write/copy/socket/code) and the host; each row is marked fp or tp in the monthly ADR-006 review.
retire_if.redesign_if: deliberate lexical evasion forms (the families in Cor-Incorporated/claude-code-harness COR-PATCHES.md: quoting, other tools' delimiters, line structure, option spelling, indirection, unread programs) show up as false positives or misses in the guard-ledger review of real use

egress.reviewed: Cor-Incorporated/claude-code-harness#1: Codex round 1 P1 x11 / P2 x2 and round 2 P1 x14; adversarial round 1 CRITICAL x1 / MEDIUM x1 / LOW x4 and round 2 CRITICAL 0 / HIGH 0 / MEDIUM x1 / LOW x2. Every input is a Go test in the mirror, red on the head it was found at.
egress.out_of_scope: A lexical guard, not a sandbox (owner gate 2026-10-31): the forms an agent ordinarily types show 0 CRITICAL/HIGH; deliberate lexical evasions are known residuals. Every deny still reaches guard-ledger.jsonl.
